oneTapForegroundCheckpoint20261120.diagnosticScope: Both runs modified only the display of bounded error codes in private copies of the same simulator bundle. No stage, position, admission, or server response was supplied by diagnostics.
oneTapForegroundCheckpoint20261120.cause: A saved-route departure can reach prepare while a foreground checkpoint check is still active. The first guard mistook that check for a conflicting mutation and discarded the tap.
oneTapForegroundCheckpoint20261120.fix: A live departure intent waits for the in-flight checkpoint, then checks cancellation, generation, outstanding stops and session ownership before it can arm. Competing mutations remain exclusive.

diagnostic.nativeStack: CLClientIsLocationServicesEnabled waiting for a synchronous XPC reply. Simulator locationd was waiting on a background scheduler submission.

regularRelease26.fix: Time-bound a passive read of iOS location service and authorization state. Return a distinct recoverable status with explicit retry after twelve seconds. The system permission prompt retains unlimited user decision time and no failed passive check can start a session.
